nodes.name: vite.config.ts
nodes.summary: Configures React builds, the HETU PWA manifest and selective runtime caches, validates Supabase settings for Capacitor builds, aliases source imports, and strips hosted topper-note PDFs from native bundles.
nodes.languageNotes: The mode-aware Vite configuration conditionally disables PWA generation for Capacitor and injects a closeBundle hook that keeps large hosted reference PDFs out of Android artifacts.
